additional_info.subject: RE: ID0432256-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP/T2170004376] error while charging CRM:02684000323
additional_info.body:
Dear Valerio Filocamo,
I hope you're doing well.
We've analyzed the session logs for given timestamp, The session was interrupted by a temporary V2G (Vehicle-to-Grid) error, which typically indicates a communication issue between the EV and the charger or grid.
As it appears to have been a one-time occurrence, no further action is needed at this point. Should the issue arise again, please don't hesitate to reach out.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
